observed_structure: Each thread accumulates squared input values into an FP32 register.
A first simd_sum reduces that register within its SIMDgroup.
Threadgroup storage is initialized and synchronized before SIMDgroup lane zero publishes one partial.
A second threadgroup barrier orders partial publication before SIMDgroup zero loads the partial slots.
A second simd_sum reduces those threadgroup partials, and lane zero publishes one precise inverse-root-mean scalar before a final barrier.
variant_notes: This specialization materializes a single inverse-root-mean value in threadgroup memory before a final barrier.
Its local input statistic is a sum of squares rather than a general caller-provided accumulator.
